parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the group that you want to create. The group ID must meet the following conventions:

*   The ID must be 7 to 64 characters in length. It must start with GID\_ or GID- and can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_).
*   The ID cannot be changed after the group is created. For more information, see [Terms](~~42420~~).

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance to which the group belongs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun onsmqtt create-group-id --group-id GID_test --instance-id mqtt-cn-0pp1ldu0000 --tag Value=test Key=test --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun onsmqtt CreateGroupId --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key test --InstanceId 'mqtt-cn-0pp1ldu0000' --Tag.1.Value test --GroupId GID_test
